title: Add Native Sidecar InitContainer
prompt:
Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-sidecar` writes access logs to shared volume `/var/log/app` (`emptyDir`), and needs a Kubernetes native sidecar streaming helper alongside the main container.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Add a native sidecar `initContainer` named `log-shipper` (`image: busybox:1.36`, `restartPolicy: Always`) to Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-sidecar`.
2. Mount volume `logs` at `/var/log/app` on `log-shipper` running `["sh", "-c", "tail -F /var/log/app/access.log"]`.
3. Ensure Deployment `web` rolls out cleanly with `1` ready replica.
hints: A Kubernetes native sidecar is defined in `spec.template.spec.initContainers[]` with `restartPolicy: Always`.
Export Deployment YAML with `k -n cka-sidecar get deploy web -o yaml > deploy.yaml`, edit, and re-apply.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-sidecar get deploy web -o yaml > deploy.yaml && k apply -f deploy.yaml

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-config
  namespace: cka-sidecar
data:
  log_path: /var/log/app/access.log
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-sidecar
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      volumes:
      - name: logs
        emptyDir: {}
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sh", "-c", "touch /var/log/app/access.log && while true; do echo ok >> /var/log/app/access.log; sleep 2; done"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log/app

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-sidecar
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      volumes:
      - name: logs
        emptyDir: {}
      initContainers:
      - name: log-shipper
        image: busybox:1.36
        restartPolicy: Always
        command: ["sh", "-c", "touch /var/log/app/access.log && tail -F /var/log/app/access.log"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log/app
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sh", "-c", "touch /var/log/app/access.log && while true; do echo ok >> /var/log/app/access.log; sleep 2; done"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log/app

reference_solution: Add `initContainers` entry `log-shipper` with `restartPolicy: Always` and matching `/var/log/app` mount.
